paper.title: Effects of magnetic–vortical interactions on magnetic splitting

sources.version: Published version; title, authors, DOI and journal checked on first page

text_evidence_sources: Main-paper and appendix equations and captions

claims.claim: Curvature and transverse magnetic-strength gradients generate a splitting vortex pair in the chosen initial field.
claims.boundary: Early-time, restricted frame-field structure; zero-field and zero-curvature singularities.

claims.claim: Comparable aligned vorticity inhibits dipole formation and tube splitting.
claims.boundary: Order-of-magnitude strength estimate, not universal threshold; partial initial splitting is reported.

claims.claim: Early magnetic/vortex line geometries approximately share material transport.
claims.boundary: Neglect diffusion and require source alignment; not an exact general resistive-MHD theorem.

claims.claim: Energy histories depend strongly on small angular changes.
claims.boundary: Figure 12 kinetic trend contradicts prose; no asserted exact optimum.

claims.claim: Energy curves approach convergence at high resolution in one low-diffusivity case.
claims.boundary: Intermediate grid legend 736³ conflicts with text 768³; not topology convergence.
